name: toolroomos-workspace
description: Root workspace orchestrating ToolRoomOS frontend, backend, and infrastructure.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --prefix backend && npx --prefix backend prisma migrate dev
scripts.prod: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
